title: Never Start at Zero
description: Mute-first visual cut of the compounding-profiles VSL. Timed to punch, not to the 2:15 VO. Full spoken script lives in source-never-start-at-zero.md.

beats.voiceover: Here's the dirty secret about every form you've ever sent. The moment someone hits submit… their answer falls into a spreadsheet and dies there.
beats.caption: Submit. Spreadsheet. Dead.

beats.voiceover: No name you'll remember. No follow-up. Next time you start over. From zero. Again.
beats.caption: Next time you start at zero. Again.

beats.voiceover: That's not a survey problem. That's a relationship problem. They're not rows — they're at different stages.
beats.caption: Not a survey problem. A relationship problem.

beats.voiceover: What if every answer didn't just get recorded — it got remembered?
beats.caption: Not recorded. Remembered.

beats.voiceover: Each reply, conversation, and call builds a profile that gets richer every time you talk.
beats.caption: A profile that gets richer every time.

beats.voiceover: Every interaction compounds. You never start at zero.
beats.caption: You never start at zero.

beats.voiceover: See who's at what stage — and who's ready to move.
beats.caption: See who's ready to move.

beats.voiceover: Follow up in one click, in context.
beats.caption: Follow up in one click. In context.

beats.voiceover: Turn a warm answer into a booked meeting without breaking the thread.
beats.caption: Book it in the thread.

beats.voiceover: Go deeper over voice or video. A conversation, not a chore.
beats.caption: A conversation. Not a chore.

beats.voiceover: One link. Beautiful. One question at a time.
beats.caption: One link. One question at a time.

beats.voiceover: I ran one survey. It didn't just give me answers. It gave me a pitch.
beats.caption: Not answers. A pitch.

beats.voiceover: Their words. Their patterns. Walk in from everything you already know.
beats.caption: Walk in from everything you already know.

beats.voiceover: Stop collecting responses that die. Start relationships that compound. Send your first ask free.
beats.caption: Send your first ask. Never start at zero again.
